title: A walk's press on a picture tile, swatch or colour well in the panel takes effect again
goal: The scripted walks that check the app click its panel buttons the way a person would. Since about 26 October a walk's click on a picture tile, a colour swatch or the custom colour well lands in the right place and does nothing, while sliders and segmented controls still respond. Every new panel feature this week has been closed without a walk proving its buttons work, and one of the user's own asks cannot finish until this is fixed.
notes: Reproduced by the digest on 2026-11-01 on the probe build in dist: `Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/arrow-styles-walk.json --no-build` -> status failed, step 18 '"Arrow style Hand-drawn" in Arrow Style, off at window (1219, 531), one click; settled after 6 looks; ... no view bodies counted', step 19 'FAILED: the control called "Arrow style Hand-drawn" in "Arrow Style" reads "Arrow Style, off", not "Arrow Style, on"'. Four runners hit the same dead press in two days, each logged on walks-that-fail-in-the-full-sweep-26: arrow-styles-walk and chip-styles-picking-walk (2026-10-31 14:49, also with setup front:true, while segmented arrow-endings-walk passed in the same build), any-colour-chip-reads-walk step 15 (Custom well opens no picker, a press on 'Color Green' leaves the arrow #FF3B30), picker-controls-walk at its first press inside the picker, measure-chip-styles taps (2026-11-01 05:08), and chip-styles-picking-walk step 18 on clean HEAD d08583a7 (2026-11-01 07:10). arrow-styles-walk last passed in the 2026-10-23 sweep, so the change sits between then and 2026-10-26. Related and possibly the same cause: the brush chooser popover over the tool bar does not open under a walk, by press or windowClick, even with the window key and in front (2026-10-31 06:35 on the walk task). The press path is the posted-mouse-event press in Sources/Photonz/Playtest. Blocks any-colour-you-pick-for-an-arrow-or-measurement (user ask), whose only open item is its walk.
acceptance: Find what changed between the 2026-10-23 sweep (arrow-styles-walk green) and 2026-10-26, and say in this task's log why a press on a picture tile, swatch or colour well stopped reaching the button while segmented controls still do

arrow-styles-walk, chip-styles-picking-walk and picker-controls-walk each pass twice in a row with Scripts/playtest.sh --no-build on a fresh probe build, at Next defaults, with no front:true added to make them pass
The press reaches a real button the way a person's click does: no walk-only shortcut that sets the value without going through the control
The brush chooser popover opens under a walk press, or the log says why it is a separate cause and where it went
A unit or harness test fails if a walk press on a plain button stops taking effect again

The presses three tasks closed on 2026-11-01 without walking are walked here: a press on Color Orange and Reset Colors in measure-chip-styles-walk, and a press on Size S/M/L and on Advanced Show in arrow-appearance-simple-walk, each passing at Next defaults
any-colour-you-pick-for-an-arrow-or-measurement is pointed at this task as its dependency, and its walk is run once here and the result written on it
A walk's press on the perspective popover's presets and slider (over the canvas) and the tool bar's Info button takes effect, and perspective-pill-walk presses them

log.note: owns these walks: arrow-styles-walk, chip-styles-picking-walk, picker-controls-walk

Also dead on the canvas overlays (2026-11-01, perspective-pill task): with the perspective popover open under the 3D pill, press 'Strong' in 'Perspective' (and 'None', and 'Slider' across 0.75) at the right window point did nothing; the hit view was the editor's AppKitWindowHostingView and the window was not key. A windowClick at the same point, taking the front, did nothing either. press 'Info' in the tool bar did nothing in the same run (F8 through the new toggleTransformValues stand-in opens it). Once presses work, add to perspective-pill-walk: press Strong in Perspective then expectCamera 90, press Slider in Perspective across 0.75, press Subtle in Transform Perspective then expectCamera 20.
